Why does Hanuman ji sit with his eyes closed, smiling? Because in water, on earth and across the sky, only Ram carries us across. 🙏

जल थल गगन मण्डल में राम
राम ही पार लगावेंगे

Wherever Hanuman ji goes, he carries one name in his heart. Watch it turn around him, राम राम राम, while he sits in the quiet of the forest.

Save this for the days you need a little peace, and send it to someone who needs Ram’s name today.

Stories of Hanuman ji, Ram and the gods, written for kids: Rishi Katha books, Books 1–3 as a set for ₹500 at rishikatha.com (link in bio).
